line_search: Original compiled external-moment Newton adapter, spherical geodesic cap 0.5, reduction 0.5, strict decrease of raw equation residual. Recompute native baseline before replaying perturbed scores.
use: Train-only sensitivity. Seeded and registered-query starts stay separate. The predeclared short prefixes may end before convergence. Score reconstruction and counterfactuals must reproduce captured native residuals and positivity of the multiplier. A scalar or tangent-direction counterexample cannot establish a population P95 screening threshold.

extended_T2_registered.reason: The predeclared two-iteration prefix had two accepted full geodesic cuts; extend the same trajectory to seek scored and geometric backtracks. Thresholds, seed, starting query, and native decision logic stay fixed.

other_T2_scope: After the primary case stopped without a backtrack, replay the listed already-registered training shapes under the same extended prefix. Every attempted start is retained.

coherent_J_probe.direction: raw tangent of original first trial at each base
coherent_J_probe.field: e_i=sign_i*0.01*mass*L*sin(5*u dot (q_hat-q_base_hat)) for moments x and y; bounded to 1% per component, with 5% operator row norm over all normalized raw directions
coherent_J_probe.oracle: fresh original Cherchi moment plus raw differential at every counterfactual coordinate; recompute same native static maximum-mass residual with and without the analytic error
